# Certificates of Quality — Purely Plant GmbH
### Intermediate bulk · dry cannabis flower for medical use · 17.09.2026

172 certificates, drawn by the Claude Design package `PP_CoQ_Handoff_2026-09-16`.
One A4 page each, fonts embedded, no draft stamp, Section 04 conformity decision ticked.
The signature boxes carry no scan: each keeps its line and the space above it, and the
certificate is signed by hand once printed (Head of QC, 17.09.2026).

Every page of the merged documents is bookmarked with its certificate code and P lot.
All PDFs are **vector** — fonts embedded, gradients opaque, no blend modes — prepared for a laser printer rather than flattened to a raster.

## How to read a result cell

The RESULT column of Section 02 is a single ink, dark navy `#1B3A5C`, on every cell.
No colour marks an edge case: a result is read against the `ACC. CRITERIA` column beside it,
and the conformity decision is in Section 04.

`[NT]` — **not tested**: the determination was not performed in that testing round. It is
glossed in the note under the table on every certificate that prints it. Aflatoxin B₁
(#10.1) and Ochratoxin A (#10.3) are `[NT]` on the release certificates and determined at
the 12-month retest, on every batch of all three tranches.

`[ — ]` appears only in Section 01 and in the Section 03 work-order row, where it means a
**document** has not been located — a different statement from a determination not performed.

## One thing still outstanding

**`CoQ-PP_26-149`** (P050202 · GP Grape Pie Grade II, tranche 3 retest) is the only
certificate in the set still printing `[NT]` on Aflatoxin B₁ and Ochratoxin A. Its source,
Farmahem `227-18-М/26`, is a scan that no reader on this desk could open — neither the
desk's extraction nor the Head of QC's own pass returned text for it. The other 29 tranche 3
retests carry the full mycotoxin panel from that same 16.09.2026 intake.

Open `227-18-М/26` by hand and the certificate completes. It is registered as **OI-48**.
